scope: BioPython Studio only; BioCompute and ImageLab excluded
count_definition: 156 DISTINCT competencies, not 156 shipped interactive lessons or mandatory screens

modules.title: Functions, files, testing and actual tools
Pandas, biological metadata and data QA
Real microscopy images, provenance and axes
Biopython, DNA sequences and introductory NGS
Defensible baseline ML for biological data

competencies.title: Read and write a text file
Create and run a local Python virtual environment
Test a function with pytest-style checks
Inspect and commit a reproducible Git change
Decode an image into an array
Convert pixel area to physical units
Inspect a TIFF/OME-TIFF in a notebook
Audit paired study designs and compute matched change
Distinguish standard deviation from standard error
Bootstrap at the correct unit level
Validate DNA bases and ambiguity policy
Compute and interpret DNA GC fraction
Trim reads by a documented rule
Create a clear figure from new observations
Complete a small sequence/NGS QC project
Complete a group-safe biological ML project

removed_v2.158: unseen microscopy transfer as project assessment

progress_policy: Preserve all saved code, completion and hint records for 25/61 lesson versions; never infer new independent or retained mastery from old results.
path_policy: Prerequisite DAG; microscopy recommended, sequence and ML optional. Use real-image context in first session.
release_gates: G0 deployed Pyodide/HPA real runtime QA
G2 61-ID migration tests and DAG unlock system
G3 foundation plus real notebook/venv/Git transfer
G4 calibrated microscopy and inference pathway
G5 optional sequences/ML, projects and release QA
